primitives.name: Source Freshness Service Level Agreement
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Brutal audit - CRITICAL: active, legally usable data coverage remains smaller than the seeded source universe.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{legal}': 'dimensionless, legally usable coverage ratio', 'C_{seeded}': 'dimensionless, seeded source universe coverage ratio'}
primitives.assumptions: Legal usability is a binary condition dependent on coverage ratio; coverage is a monotonic function of time since last update.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_legal < C_seeded, data integrity is compromised by legal gaps.

layer2.mapping: GSI inference engine uses C_legal/C_seeded ratio to compute posterior trust scores for each data source.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of legally usable records to total seeded records.

primitives.name: Trust-Coverage-Conflict Triad
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Coverage, source trust, conflict, freshness, proof, comps, archetypes, alerts, versioning, competitive, and king-standard foundations.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'dimensionless trust score', 'C': 'dimensionless coverage score', 'F': 'dimensionless conflict frequency', 'S': 'dimensionless freshness score'}
primitives.assumptions: Trust, coverage, and conflict form an orthogonal triad under a shared probabilistic framework.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F > threshold, T decays exponentially with C.

layer2.mapping: GSE state transition graph encodes T-C-F relationships as Markovian dynamics.
layer2.telemetry: Joint entropy of T, C, F across all sources.

primitives.name: Data UX Comprehension Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: premium UX must explain trust, coverage, conflicts, and missing data in ten seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U': 'dimensionless UX clarity index', 't_{max}': 'seconds, maximum user comprehension time'}
primitives.assumptions: UX clarity is inversely proportional to information density within t_max.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When U < 0.5, comprehension fails for 90% of users.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes U as a function of data density and visual abstraction layers.
layer2.telemetry: User engagement time vs. data density in UI components.

The freshness SLA primitive establishes a stochastic model where legal usability is a conditional probability of coverage. The trust-coverage-conflict triad operates as a multi-dimensional vector space, where each axis represents a distinct aspect of data quality. The UX comprehension layer acts as a projection operator that maps high-dimensional data into a low-dimensional perceptual space. Failure modes emerge when conflict frequency exceeds trust thresholds, causing cascading degradation in both data fidelity and user perception. The system's robustness depends on maintaining a balance between these three primitives through dynamic feedback loops.
